tools.name: pick_secret_santa_gift
tools.description: Filters Santa's vetted 212 hand-checked gift ideas - the Secret Santa subset of the shared 255-idea bank it shares with its sister site The Present Picker, sorted here for Secret Santa by the budget band your group agreed for its draw - with strict parameters, and returns up to three picks. Paramete

tools.name: explain_secret_santa_rules
tools.description: The rules and fairness answers pickmysecretsanta.com itself publishes, worded the site's way. Topics: basics (the classic rules), fairness_and_secrecy (how the sealed draw works and its honest limits), organizer_view (the organizer sees names and links, never matches), keep_apart_pairs, late_joiner

tools.name: plan_secret_santa_setup
tools.description: Configures a Secret Santa group of 3 to 30 right here in chat and hands the organizer one pre-filled link to pickmysecretsanta.com, where the zero-knowledge draw runs in their browser - no server sees the matches, and each match will live inside one private link - hidden from plain sight, not locked
